circle.data-tooltip-text:
• n is a copy of the caller's value
• n's value is copied to the caller
• n goes out of scope
s acquires ownership of a resource
s's resource is captured (moved) by closure f
s goes out of scope. No resource is dropped.
Closure f captures: s (moved)
f is moved into the call (an FnOnce closure can only be called once). s, which f captured, is dropped during the call
f goes out of scope. No resource is dropped.
_x is initialized with the value f() returns
_x goes out of scope
t acquires ownership of a resource
t's resource is captured (moved) by closure g
t goes out of scope. No resource is dropped.
Closure g captures: t (moved)
g is moved into the call (an FnOnce closure can only be called once). t, which g captured, is dropped during the call
g goes out of scope. No resource is dropped.
_y is initialized with the value wrap() returns
_y goes out of scope

u's resource is captured (moved) by closure h
u goes out of scope. No resource is dropped.
Closure h captures: u (moved)
h is moved into the call (an FnOnce closure can only be called once). u, which h captured, is dropped during the call
h goes out of scope. No resource is dropped.
z is initialized with a None value
z is assigned a new value

g.data-tooltip-text:
• z's value is immutably borrowed by println!; z is read-only while the borrow is live
• println! reads from z through an implicit reference, so z isn't moved
• z's value is no longer immutably borrowed

circle.data-tooltip-text: z goes out of scope
w acquires ownership of a resource
w's resource is captured (moved) by closure k
w goes out of scope. No resource is dropped.
Closure k captures: w (moved)
k is moved into the call (an FnOnce closure can only be called once). w, which k captured, is dropped during the call
k goes out of scope. No resource is dropped.
v acquires ownership of a resource

g.data-tooltip-text:
• v's resource is mutably borrowed by push; v can't be used while the borrow is live
• push reads from/writes to v (implicitly mutably borrowed)
• v's resource is no longer mutably borrowed
v goes out of scope. Its resource is dropped.
